name: DI Submission Status
query: select 'Sales Invoice' as "Document Type:Data:130", si.name as "Document:Data:170", si.posting_date as "Date:Date:100", si.customer as "Party:Data:200", si.grand_total as "Amount:Currency:130", ifnull(si.di_integration_id, '') as "FBR Invoice No:Data:240", ifnull(si.di_post_attempts, 0) as "Attempts:Int:80", case when ifnull(si.di_integration_id, '') = '' then 'Not posted' else 'Posted' end as "Status:Data:110" from `tabSales Invoice` si where si.docstatus = 1 union all select 'Sale Tax Invoice', sti.name, sti.invoice_date, sti.buyer, sti.total_sales_with_taxes, ifnull(sti.fbr_invoice_no, ''), ifnull(sti.di_post_attempts, 0), case when ifnull(sti.fbr_invoice_no, '') = '' then 'Not posted' else 'Posted' end from `tabSale Tax Invoice` sti where sti.docstatus = 1 order by 3 desc, 2 desc
